title: Waterfront and gardening

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Bring recreation and care for surroundings into one vocabulary so city life includes both public space and personal activity.
strategic_value: A paddleboarder, waterfront building and gardeners can give Helsinki’s environmental scenes a human scale.
demonstration: A dark-blue water shape with paddleboarder and sailboat sits left; a white building, tall black trees and gardening figures fill the right.
practical_value: Compare water, architecture and gardening elements as separable groups for a scene.
